title: 통일ㆍ북한 연구비 지급 규정 / queue:ARTICLE:5:0:00005:part:1/1
full_text:
Article 5 (Duties of Researchers)
(1) A person whose research plan is approved under Article 4 (hereinafter referred to as a "researcher") shall conduct research in accordance with the research plan approved by the President of the National Institute for Peaceful Unification and Democratic Education and submit at least one interim report on research progress during the research period. <Amended on Mar. 30, 2021; Nov. 4, 2025>
(2) A researcher shall submit a final report to the President of the National Institute for Peaceful Unification and Democratic Education within one month after the research period specified in the approved research plan expires. <Amended on Mar. 30, 2021; Nov. 4, 2025>
